title: Inverse-gravity Duplex (Rapier)
description: Every SceneObject in the Duplex IFC building (loaded as XGF) becomes a dynamic Rapier body, the world's gravity vector points up, and the house lifts off the slab and disassembles itself in mid-air. A separate slab stays fixed as a spatial reference. "Toggle gravity" flips the vector so the parts fall back into a chaotic heap. Physics runs through ScenePhysics with Rapier loaded from a CDN at runtime; the SDK itself never bundles Rapier.
